tutorial.arcane.title: Arcane Guide
tutorial.arcane.page1:
ARCANE GUIDE

Magic here is a language: glyphs in order form a sentence. The same sequence always does the same thing.

You win by learning, not by bigger numbers.
tutorial.arcane.page2:
1. WORKBENCH

Place the Arcane Workbench and right-click it. Pick glyphs in order, name the spell and save. On the bench a spell has 100% power; in the field, 30%.
tutorial.arcane.page3:
2. GRIMOIRE

Press G to open the grimoire. V casts the active spell, B switches spells. The grimoire floats beside you and ALWAYS drops when you die, with everything inside.
tutorial.arcane.page4:
3. FINDING GLYPHS

Watch mages cast, find glyph notes in structure chests, study scrolls. The more you use a glyph, the better you master it.
tutorial.arcane.page5:
4. ELEMENTS

Storm is stronger in the rain. Fire fails in water. Frost puts out the target's fire. Venom thrives in swamps. Read the terrain before you fight.
tutorial.arcane.page6:
5. RITUALS

Place the Arcane Altar and draw a circle with chalk or the Compass. The bigger the circle, the more power and area. Spells with ritual glyphs only work there.

glyph.arcane.self.desc: Form: the spell happens on you.
glyph.arcane.touch.desc: Form: affects whatever you aim at, up close (3 blocks).
glyph.arcane.projectile.desc: Form: fires an orb that applies the spell where it lands (creature or block).
glyph.arcane.ray.desc: Form: an instant beam that hits the first creature or block you aim at, at any distance (lower the range to limit it).
glyph.arcane.aura.desc: Form: affects every creature around you (except you).
glyph.arcane.damage.desc: Effect: hurts the target. The creature will turn on you.
glyph.arcane.fire.desc: Effect: sets creatures ablaze. Does nothing to blocks (use Ignite).
glyph.arcane.push.desc: Effect: knocks the target away from you. On yourself, it is a forward dash.
glyph.arcane.slow.desc: Effect: the target moves slowly for a while.
glyph.arcane.poison.desc: Effect: poisons the target, wearing it down (never kills).
glyph.arcane.speed.desc: Effect: the target runs faster for a while.
glyph.arcane.levitate.desc: Effect: the target floats upward for a few seconds.
glyph.arcane.shield.desc: Effect: grants absorption hearts to the target.
glyph.arcane.thunder.desc: Effect: a lightning bolt strikes the target. Beware of the fire.
glyph.arcane.explode.desc: Effect: explodes at the target without breaking blocks. Hurts everyone nearby, you included.
glyph.arcane.blink.desc: Effect: you teleport to the spot you are aiming at.
glyph.arcane.ignite.desc: Effect: lights a fire on the target block, if there is free space above.
glyph.arcane.dig.desc: Effect: breaks the target block if it is soft (dirt, sand, wood, plain stone). Never breaks chests.
glyph.arcane.grow.desc: Effect: plants around the target grow as if bone-mealed (radius 3; strength = how many doses).
glyph.arcane.light.desc: Effect: lights an invisible light at the aimed spot (or above the creature). Duration 0 = forever.
glyph.arcane.water_walk.desc: Effect: the water surface holds the target like ground. Sneak to sink.
glyph.arcane.breathe.desc: Effect: the target breathes underwater for a while.
glyph.arcane.night_eye.desc: Effect: the target sees in the dark for a while.
glyph.arcane.feather.desc: Effect: the target falls slowly like a feather, with no fall damage.
glyph.arcane.time_stop.desc: Original: time stops in a sphere (radius 16). Creatures, projectiles and falling blocks freeze; only you move.
glyph.arcane.rewind.desc: Original: the target (or you) returns to where it was, with the health it had, up to 10 seconds ago. Clears fire and ailments.
glyph.arcane.space_collapse.desc: Original: space folds. Every creature in the radius (24) is torn to the point and crushed.
glyph.arcane.annihilate.desc: Original: erases a sphere of blocks from existence (radius 10) and wounds everything inside. Bedrock and chests resist.
glyph.arcane.eclipse.desc: Original: night and storm fall at once, and lightning strikes up to 12 monsters around (radius 64).
glyph.arcane.genesis.desc: Original: full healing, cures ailments and shields every player and peaceful creature in the radius (24), and the land blooms.
glyph.arcane.gravity_inversion.desc: Original: gravity flips in the radius (20): everything rises hard and plummets when it ends. Projectiles turn upward.
glyph.arcane.self_filter.desc: Filter: restricts the effect to you.
glyph.arcane.blocks.desc: Filter: targets blocks instead of creatures.
glyph.arcane.undead.desc: Filter: only affects the undead (zombies, skeletons...).
glyph.arcane.not_self.desc: Filter: removes you from the targets.
glyph.arcane.nearest.desc: Filter: only the creature closest to you.
glyph.arcane.wounded.desc: Filter: only creatures below half health.
glyph.arcane.area.desc: Modifier: doubles the radius of the form and effect (Aura, Explosion).
glyph.arcane.more_range.desc: Modifier: increases the form's range by 50% (Touch, Ray, Blink).
glyph.arcane.delay.desc: Modifier: what follows only happens a few seconds later.
glyph.arcane.power.desc: Modifier: +50% strength on the previous effect (damage, heal, push, level).
glyph.arcane.lengthen.desc: Modifier: doubles the previous effect's time (fire, slow, poison...).
glyph.arcane.homing.desc: Projectile modifier: the orb curves toward the nearest creature in the cone ahead (turn strength 1 to 3). Respects the filter; without one, it never chases you, allies or pets. On other forms, it does nothing.
glyph.arcane.ricochet.desc: Projectile modifier: the orb bounces off blocks up to 1 to 4 times, losing power at each bounce. Each bounce counts as a hit (On Impact fires once per bounce). On other forms, it does nothing.
glyph.arcane.fragment.desc: Projectile modifier: on hit, the orb splits into 2 to 6 smaller shards, which add up to a little more than one orb. A shard never splits again. On other forms, it does nothing.
glyph.arcane.arc.desc: Projectile modifier: the orb rises and falls on the aimed point, passing over cover (arc height in the parameter). With Homing, it only curves on the way down. On other forms, it does nothing.
glyph.arcane.on_hit_entity.desc: Condition: what follows only happens when a creature is hit.
glyph.arcane.on_hit_block.desc: Condition: what follows only happens when a block is hit.
glyph.arcane.after_seconds.desc: Condition: what follows only happens after a few seconds.
glyph.arcane.low_health.desc: Condition: what follows only happens if you are below half health.
glyph.arcane.sneaking.desc: Condition: what follows only happens while you are sneaking.
glyph.arcane.night.desc: Condition: what follows only happens at night.
glyph.arcane.in_water.desc: Condition: what follows only happens while you are in water.
glyph.arcane.activate.desc: Activator: triggers the rituals you stored in altars up to 48 blocks away (the circle is checked on the spot).
glyph.arcane.wave.desc: Form: a cone-shaped wave in front of you, affecting every creature it reaches.
glyph.arcane.pillar.desc: Form: a vertical column at the point you aim at (creatures and the block hit).
glyph.arcane.barrier.desc: Form: raises a wall of energy in front of you (3x3 at radius 3; Area and radius enlarge it). With Dome, Sphere or Ring it becomes a shell around the center. Following glyphs hit the blocks and anyone inside or touching.
glyph.arcane.mark.desc: Effect: marks the target (it glows). The Marked can be picked later with the Marked filter.
glyph.arcane.gravity.desc: Effect: the target gets heavy and is slammed down (hard landing). Drops sand, gravel and anvils. Several Gravity glyphs add up.
glyph.arcane.attract.desc: Effect: pulls the target toward you.
glyph.arcane.blind.desc: Effect: the target is blinded for a while.
glyph.arcane.wither.desc: Effect: the target withers (continuous Wither damage).
glyph.arcane.invisible.desc: Effect: the target turns invisible for a while, armor and items included, without particles. Only a blurry distortion gives it away, more visible the faster it moves. Reveal undoes it.
glyph.arcane.cut.desc: Effect: physical damage (armor reduces it). Shears sheep and, on blocks, instantly cuts leaves.
glyph.arcane.freeze.desc: Effect: freezes creatures (slowness and cold) and, on blocks, turns water to ice and lava to obsidian.
glyph.arcane.marked.desc: Filter: only creatures that have been Marked.
glyph.arcane.unmarked.desc: Filter: only creatures that have NOT been Marked.
glyph.arcane.allies.desc: Filter: players, tamed animals, villagers and iron golems.
glyph.arcane.wood.desc: Filter: only wooden blocks (logs and planks).
glyph.arcane.group.desc: Modifier: opens a group. A modifier after End Group affects every effect in the group.
glyph.arcane.end_group.desc: Modifier: closes the group opened by Group.
glyph.arcane.weaken.desc: Modifier: half the strength of the previous effect (damage, heal, push, level). Makes the spell cheaper.
glyph.arcane.repeat.desc: Modifier: repeats the previous effect (the parameter is the total number of times). Each repeat costs the effect again.
glyph.arcane.on_hurt.desc: Condition: arms the spell on you: what follows only happens when you take damage (once, for up to 60 s).
glyph.arcane.low_mana.desc: Condition: what follows only happens if your mana is below 20%.
glyph.arcane.standing_still.desc: Condition: what follows only happens while you stand still on the ground.
glyph.arcane.summon_wolves.desc: RITUAL form (minor): summons tamed Spectral Wolves that fight for you for a while. You pick the number (count) and size (1-3): bigger ones use another model (Alpha, Fenrir) with more health and damage. The wolves are the targets of what follows.
glyph.arcane.summon_golem.desc: RITUAL form (medium): raises a Runic Golem that guards you for a while. One golem, and you pick its size (1-3: Guardian, Colossus, Titan, each with its own model): bigger and longer-lasting costs more mana. The golem is the target of what follows.
glyph.arcane.warp.desc: RITUAL effect (major): moves every targeted creature to the point you aim at (up to 48). With Aura or Pillar and a big circle, it displaces a whole region.
glyph.arcane.weather.desc: RITUAL effect (legendary): changes the world's weather (0 clear, 1 rain, 2 storm). Requires a Nether Star offering in the major circle.
glyph.arcane.vow_stillness.desc: Customizable vow (Pledge 1-5): bonus = 28% x pledge^0.85 (pledge 2 = +50%). Requires standing still on the ground for (pledge-1) x 1 s before casting.
glyph.arcane.vow_blood.desc: Customizable vow (Pledge 1-5): bonus = 30% x pledge^0.85 (pledge 2 = +54%). Costs 2 x pledge health and refuses if too little is left.
glyph.arcane.vow_daylight.desc: Customizable vow (Pledge 1-5): bonus = 25% x pledge^0.85 (pledge 2 = +45%). 1 day; 2 open sky; 3 no rain; 4 morning to afternoon; 5 near noon.
glyph.arcane.vow_oath.desc: You choose the penalty and how long it lasts, AFTER casting. Kind: 1 immobile, 2 silence (no other spell), 3 sealed mana, 4 fragile (+50% damage taken), 5 blind. Bonus = k x ln(1 + seconds/5), with k 0.30 / 0.22 / 0.35 / 0.25 / 0.20, capped at +150%. E.g. immobile for 30 s = +58%.
glyph.arcane.on_death.desc: Condition: arms the spell on you: what follows only happens when you die (once, for up to 60 s).
glyph.arcane.shape_dome.desc: Shape: the form becomes a half-sphere (a block shell for Barrier; only those inside for Aura). Use Area to grow the radius.
glyph.arcane.shape_sphere.desc: Shape: the form becomes a full sphere around the center.
glyph.arcane.shape_ring.desc: Shape: the form becomes a ring on the ground around the center (2 blocks high).
glyph.arcane.shape_cone.desc: Shape: the form becomes a ~100 degree cone in front of you (Wave already is). For Barrier, a curved cap.
glyph.arcane.shape_column.desc: Shape: the form becomes a vertical column at the aimed point (Pillar already is). For Barrier, a hollow cylinder.
glyph.arcane.shape_wall.desc: Shape: the form becomes a wall perpendicular to your gaze, 3 blocks ahead (Barrier already is).
glyph.arcane.origin_self.desc: Origin: the form's center becomes you, even for forms that normally aim (Pillar) or sit ahead (wall).
glyph.arcane.origin_aim.desc: Origin: the form's center becomes the point you look at (up to 32 blocks) instead of you.
glyph.arcane.zone.desc: Makes the form persistent: it repeats from the same place every interval for the chosen time, reapplying effects to whoever is inside (Aura + Fire becomes a burning field; Barrier becomes a continuous wall; Projectile becomes a turret). Parameters: seconds (up to 60) and interval (min 0.5 s). At most 2 of your zones at once. Summons ignore Zone.
glyph.arcane.domain.desc: Barrier modifier: closes a dome and keeps it. Everything inside receives the spell's effects continuously (every interval) until the dome breaks: it ends when about 10% of the shell blocks are gone, or when time runs out. The shell does not heal and does not fade on its own while the Domain lasts; breaking a piece of it ends it (and fires "When the zone ends"). Use with Barrier + Dome (or Sphere) + an effect (Heal, Damage, Slow...). Parameters: seconds (up to 60) and interval (min 0.5 s). Counts as a Zone (same limit of 2 per caster).
glyph.arcane.on_zone_end.desc: Condition: what follows only happens when this spell's zone ends (once). Without the Zone glyph, it never happens.
glyph.arcane.on_zone_enter.desc: Condition: what follows only happens to creatures that ENTER this spell's zone (once per entry, checked every pulse). Whoever was already inside when cast does not count. Without the Zone glyph, it never happens.
glyph.arcane.on_zone_exit.desc: Condition: what follows only happens to creatures that LEAVE this spell's zone (once per exit, checked every pulse). Without the Zone glyph, it never happens.
glyph.arcane.outsiders.desc: Filter: affects only those who are NOT you nor on your guest list (command /arcane guest add|remove|list). Tamed animals and summons of you or your guests are also left out. Handy for inscriptions and zones that guard your home.
glyph.arcane.blast.desc: Effect: explodes at the target DESTROYING blocks (like TNT, dropping items) and hurting nearby creatures. You are immune. Radius 1-6. Respects the server configs against block destruction.
glyph.arcane.chain.desc: Modifier: the previous effect spreads from creature to creature. Explosion and Destructive Blast detonate again, smaller, on nearby creatures (up to 3 hops, 8 extra); Damage arcs to the nearest creature at 60% per hop. Other effects ignore Chain (the preview warns).
glyph.arcane.float.desc: Effect: the target hovers and glides smoothly where it looks, as if lifted by the head (the head leads, the legs follow). W moves, Space rises, Shift sinks, Ctrl speeds up; with no input it hovers in place. Speed from 0.3 to 3 blocks per tick, duration in ticks and glide (0 to 1: with no input the body glides forward like an elytra and sinks slowly instead of stopping). It costs mana every tick while flying (more at high speed) and ends when mana runs out; the first fall after the flight deals no damage. In the Grimoire, Hold or Toggle mode keeps the flight going while you channel.
glyph.arcane.telekinesis.desc: Effect: holds creatures and blocks with your mind and carries them hovering in front of your aim. The block group is decided when you cast: one block; a sphere (Sphere 1-6) around the aimed block; or, with Same type, the connected blocks of the same material (up to 120), optionally limited by the sphere. When released, everything falls with its momentum. Distance 2-16, duration up to 20 s.
glyph.arcane.rain.desc: Effect: a local rain falls on the target: wets everyone in the area (radius 1.5-10), puts out fire and waters crops. It does not change the world weather (that is the Weather ritual).
glyph.arcane.charge.desc: Effect: you rush in a straight line at the target (or where you look), up to 16 blocks, hurting whoever is in the way. Unlike Push on yourself, which is only an impulse, and Blink, which teleports.
glyph.arcane.glide.desc: Effect: the target falls slowly for a while (slow falling), with no fall damage. This is the passive version; to really fly, use Float.
glyph.arcane.taunt.desc: Effect: hostile creatures start chasing you, dropping any other target and waking from Sleep or Fear. Does not affect players.
glyph.arcane.fear.desc: Effect: the creature drops its target and flees from you; while it lasts it will not pick you as a target (1 to 20 s). Players become weak and heavy-handed.
glyph.arcane.sleep.desc: Effect: the creature drops its target and falls asleep, still and weak, for up to 30 s. Any damage wakes it.
glyph.arcane.rumble.desc: Effect: a dry thunderclap on the target: hurts lightly, shoves outward (radius 1-8) and leaves creatures dazed for 1.5 s. Breaks no blocks and starts no fire.
glyph.arcane.darkness.desc: Effect: the target is wrapped in pulsing darkness (the game's Darkness effect): vision fades and returns. Softer than Blind.
glyph.arcane.wet.desc: Effect: leaves the creature wet for up to 60 s and puts out its fire. While wet: Thunder and storm spells hurt more, Frost freezes faster and harder, and Fire fizzles into steam. The rules live in data/arcane/interactions.
glyph.arcane.lifesteal.desc: Effect: hurts the target and gives you back 60% of the damage actually dealt. Does not work on yourself. Inverted, it becomes Life Transfer.
glyph.arcane.life_transfer.desc: Effect: you pass health to the target (1-16), never dropping below 1 heart. Inverted, it becomes Life Steal.
glyph.arcane.read_item.desc: Effect: shows in chat the item the creature is holding (or the dropped item): name, count, durability and enchantments. Informational only; changes nothing.
glyph.arcane.invert.desc: Modifier: swaps the previous effect for its opposite, with the same magnitude. Pairs: Damage and Heal, Push and Attract, Slow and Speed, Fire and Freeze, Levitate and Gravity, Life Steal and Transfer, Blind and Invisibility, Fear and Taunt. An effect with no pair ignores Invert.
glyph.arcane.on_kill.desc: Condition: arms the spell on you: what follows only happens when you kill a creature (once, for up to 60 s). With the Self form, it acts on you.
glyph.arcane.on_fall.desc: Condition: arms the spell on you: what follows only happens when you land after falling 3 blocks or more (once, for up to 60 s).
glyph.arcane.on_jump.desc: Condition: arms the spell on you: what follows only happens when you jump (once, for up to 60 s).
glyph.arcane.target_health.desc: Condition: what follows only happens if some creature target has less than X% health (X 5-95, default 30). With no creature target, it fails.
glyph.arcane.region.desc: Condition: only happens in the chosen place (kind): 1 Overworld, 2 Nether, 3 End, 4 Hot (desert, badlands, Nether), 5 Cold (snow), 6 Forest (forest, jungle, taiga), 7 Ocean, 8 Swamp.
glyph.arcane.holding.desc: Condition: only happens if your main-hand item is of the chosen kind: 0 empty hand, 1 sword or axe, 2 tool, 3 bow, crossbow or trident, 4 food, 5 block, 6 potion, 7 any item.
glyph.arcane.raining.desc: Condition: only happens while it rains or storms in the world (storm 1: storms only).
glyph.arcane.satellites.desc: Effect: orbs circle the target (1-4, 2-block radius) hurting whoever touches them, except the owner. Lasts up to 30 s.
glyph.arcane.link.desc: Effect: links the first two target creatures (or you and the target): half the damage one takes passes to the other, for up to 60 s.
glyph.arcane.trail.desc: Effect: the target leaves a trail of embers behind (up to 24 points, 6 s each) that hurts and slows whoever steps on it, except the owner.
glyph.arcane.hook.desc: Effect: you are pulled in a straight line to the target (creature, block or point), like a cable anchored to it; fall damage is cancelled. It does not pull the target (that is Attract).
glyph.arcane.climb.desc: Effect: for a while, whoever pushes against a wall climbs it (players: holding forward or jump; sneak to stop). Cancels falling.
glyph.arcane.phase.desc: Effect: you pass through a wall up to 6 blocks thick in the direction you look and come out the other side, where there is room. With no room, nothing happens.
glyph.arcane.recall.desc: Effect: the first use marks where you stand (10 min); the second takes you back, if in the same dimension. Each use spends the spell's mana.
glyph.arcane.imbue.desc: Effect: the weapon in the target's hand gains for a while (up to 5 min) and for a few hits (1-10) +2 damage and an effect: kind 1 fire, 2 frost, 3 lightning (+3), 4 venom. Melee only.
glyph.arcane.petrify.desc: Effect: the target turns to stone for up to 15 s: immobile, picking no targets and taking half damage. Damage does not break it (unlike Sleep).
glyph.arcane.acid.desc: Effect: hurts ignoring armor and corrodes the target's armor pieces (up to 60 durability points each, never breaking them).
glyph.arcane.electrify.desc: Effect: mode 0 (Electrify): damage the target takes arcs 35% to up to 2 creatures within 4 blocks. mode 1 (Conductor): lightning striking within 24 blocks lands on the target instead. Lasts up to 30 s.
glyph.arcane.contagion.desc: Effect: the target's harmful effects (and fire) spread to creatures within 1.5-8 blocks, at 60% duration. With no harmful effect on the target, nothing happens.
glyph.arcane.reanimate.desc: Effect: raises, near the target, a creature that died recently (up to 2 min ago, not a player or boss) at half health, fighting for you: it never attacks you or your other allies and goes after whoever hurt you or whoever you hurt. At most 2 at a time, lasting up to 2 min.
glyph.arcane.sense.desc: Effect: only you perceive living creatures within 4-32 blocks, even behind walls or invisible (particles for you only), and see how many there are and how many hostile.
glyph.arcane.arcane_sight.desc: Effect: night vision for a while and shows, for you only, magic residues and inscriptions within up to 32 blocks, with the count.
glyph.arcane.emit_signal.desc: Effect: briefly lights (0.5 to 10 s) an Arcane Signal block in the air where the target is; it emits redstone 15 and vanishes on its own. Only fills empty space; at most 4 per cast.
glyph.arcane.dispel.desc: Effect: on others, removes beneficial effects and magic states (Reflect, Electrify, Link, Wet, Mark); on yourself, removes harmful ones (Curse, Silence, Petrify, Fear, Sleep) and fire.
glyph.arcane.reflect.desc: Effect: for up to 20 s, projectiles hitting the target fly back at their shooter and 40% of melee damage returns to the attacker. Works on you too.
glyph.arcane.silence.desc: Effect: the target cannot cast for up to 30 s (players and mages). Does not affect ordinary attacks.
glyph.arcane.drain_mana.desc: Effect: takes 5-100 mana from target players and gives it to you. Does not affect creatures without mana.
glyph.arcane.swap.desc: Effect: you and the first target creature trade places (same dimension).
glyph.arcane.reveal.desc: Effect: removes invisibility and makes creatures within 3-24 blocks glow for 5 s, counting how many were hidden.
glyph.arcane.decoy.desc: Effect: an illusion at the aimed spot draws creatures within 20 blocks and they stop picking you as a target for up to 15 s.
glyph.arcane.curse.desc: Effect: for up to 2 min the target takes 25% more damage and cannot recover health. Dispel on yourself removes it.
glyph.arcane.after_hits.desc: Condition: arms the spell on you: what follows only happens after you land N hits on other creatures (N 2-10, default 3; for up to 60 s).
glyph.arcane.on_signal.desc: Condition: in a world inscription, changes the trigger: it fires when the block receives a redstone signal (on the rising edge), using the nearest creature (6 blocks) as origin. Outside inscriptions it does nothing.
glyph.arcane.on_near.desc: Condition: in a world inscription, changes the trigger: it fires when a creature comes within 2.5 blocks of the block (the nearest creature is the origin). Outside inscriptions it does nothing.
glyph.arcane.persistence.desc: Modifier: the drawing does not fade when it fires. Without it, a world inscription (trap, rune) disappears after firing once.
glyph.arcane.stealth.desc: Modifier: the spell leaves less trace: the world residue lasts 1/4 as long and casting makes no sound or particles. It does not hide the effect itself.
glyph.arcane.false_trace.desc: Modifier: the world residue carries a false signature (not yours) and the spell leaves a second decoy residue up to 10 blocks away. Whoever analyzes the residue is fooled.
glyph.arcane.overcharge.desc: Modifier: doubles the previous effect's strength (damage, heal, push, radius, power) and 50% more duration, but you take 1 heart of magic damage per overcharged effect (never fatal: only if you have more than 1.5 hearts). Stronger than Power, with a price.
glyph.arcane.bind.desc: Modifier: ties the previous effect to you: if it is a potion-type effect (Slow, Poison, Blind, Speed...) on another creature, it ends when you die or move more than 40 blocks away. Other effect types ignore Bind.
glyph.arcane.pocket.desc: Effect: opens your Arcane Pocket, a 13-item space only yours (like an Ender Chest) that stays with you when you die. It will not open during recent combat nor accept shulkers, the grimoire or pages.
glyph.arcane.focus.desc: Form: delivers only the living creature under your aim (up to 24 blocks, never through walls). It does not touch blocks or empty points and has no effect of its own: made for Attract, Mark, Link and others that only make sense on a creature. With no creature in your aim the spell fails and costs no mana.
glyph.arcane.restore.desc: Effect: recomposes, within 2-16 blocks (default 10), gradually, the blocks spells destroyed in the last 2 minutes (explosions, Cut, Damage, ice and fire), where nobody has built since. It returns no items: explosions drop no loot (configurable). Charges a little mana per block that comes back.
glyph.arcane.chorus.desc: Modifier: the spell only fires if 2-4 players cast it together, inside the circle that appears on the ground around whoever starts (radius 8, 3 s for the others). Everyone needs the same spell. Strength rises 35% per extra participant (max x2.4) and the mana is split among them. Without enough people nothing happens and nobody pays.
glyph.arcane.on_barrier_break.desc: Condition: what follows waits for someone to break by hand or with a tool a block (explosions and spells do not break barriers) of this spell's barrier; it runs once, at the break point, on creatures within 3 blocks of it. The barrier fading by itself does not count. Without a barrier it never happens. Waits up to 15 min.
glyph.arcane.pierce.desc: Modifier: +20% of the previous effect's damage becomes piercing, ignoring armor, protection enchantments, Resistance, Petrify's reduction and boss toughness. Stacks without limit (5 layers = 100%), but each extra Pierce in the same spell costs double the previous one.
glyph.arcane.seal_creature.desc: Effect: golden chains hold the creature for 2 s and then banish it into an item (Sealed Creature), which releases it again when used on a block. Your max mana must reach the creature's level (health + armor); otherwise the chains snap. Bosses resist; players are only held, and only if your max mana reaches theirs.
glyph.arcane.read_residue.desc: Effect: on the spell residue closest to the aimed point (up to 8 blocks), shows how many glyphs the spell had and in which order. The ones you do not know show as ???.
glyph.arcane.track_possession.desc: Effect: senses which way YOUR lost or stolen grimoire is (on the ground, with someone, on a study desk or inside a Hydra), up to 500 blocks and in the same dimension. The direction is off by up to 30 degrees, less as you get closer.
glyph.arcane.paired_portal.desc: Effect: links where you stand to the aimed point for a few seconds (up to 30 s): whoever steps into one circle comes out of the other. Does not cross dimensions.
glyph.arcane.counterspell.desc: Effect: interrupts spells. After "On Seeing a Cast", it cancels the spell you saw being cast if this one's strength (mana with charge, ritual and crystal) is at least that spell's cost; the caster loses the mana. Without that condition, it cuts what the targets are channeling (charge, hold, toggle).
glyph.arcane.lock.desc: Effect: the aimed door, trapdoor, gate or chest only opens for you and your guests. It becomes 20 times harder for others to break (not unbreakable). Dispel removes the lock (free for the owner; others need a strong spell).
glyph.arcane.seal_bench.desc: Effect: the aimed workbench obeys only you: nobody else opens it, takes your grimoire resting on it or studies on it. Lasts until you remove it with Dispel; other mages need a strong spell (30+ mana) to break it.
glyph.arcane.baptize.desc: Effect: names the area around the aimed point (radius 4 to 128). The name is this spell's name. Anyone who enters sees it as a title. Each mage can have up to 5 named areas.
glyph.arcane.mend.desc: Effect: restores 10% of the max durability of the target's held item. Weak and expensive on purpose: it does not replace the Mending enchantment.
glyph.arcane.organize.desc: Effect: merges equal stacks and sorts the aimed chest; without a chest, sorts the target's inventory (the hotbar is left alone).
glyph.arcane.silent_step.desc: Effect: for a while (up to 5 min), everything the target does to move makes no sound and no vibration: steps, jumps, falls, swimming and flying. The Warden and sculk sensors do not notice.
glyph.arcane.mark_point.desc: Effect: saves the aimed point for you (up to 3; the oldest goes) and shows, only to you, a column of light on it for 1 minute. Remember lists the saved points.
glyph.arcane.collect.desc: Effect: pulls every loose item within 8 to 32 blocks to you (much farther than picking things up).
glyph.arcane.donate_mana.desc: Effect: passes your mana to the target players (up to the chosen amount); 80% of what leaves you arrives.
glyph.arcane.warm.desc: Effect: the reverse of Freeze. Removes cold and slowness from the target creatures and melts ice and snow near them.
glyph.arcane.rest_zone.desc: Effect: slow regeneration and slower hunger on the targets, but only for those who neither dealt nor took damage in the last 2 minutes. Combine with Zone and a filter (Allies, Not Me...) for the list of who rests.
glyph.arcane.last_breath.desc: Effect: for the next 10 minutes, the target's first death becomes 1 health instead, with the totem animation and a flash. Only once per game day for each creature.
glyph.arcane.cook.desc: Effect: roasts up to 5 raw foods at a time (items on the ground near the targets or in your off hand). Does not work on metal or other furnace recipes.
glyph.arcane.dry.desc: Effect: dries the target creatures (removes wetness and fire); near the targets, wet sponges dry and mud turns to dirt.
glyph.arcane.harvest.desc: Effect: harvests the ripe crops around the targets (radius up to 16) and replants them.
glyph.arcane.herd.desc: Effect: the target animals follow you for a while (up to 1 min).
glyph.arcane.pet.desc: Effect: the target animal gets hearts and recovers a little health.
glyph.arcane.echo.desc: Effect: a pulse shows, only to you, the outline of the caves around you (dots of light on hidden walls), within up to 32 blocks.
glyph.arcane.prospect.desc: Effect: gives a vague hint of the ores around (few, some, many), which is the most common and which way the biggest vein lies.
glyph.arcane.remember.desc: Effect: shows where you last died and last slept, and the points you marked.
glyph.arcane.echo_past.desc: Effect: shows, only to you, silhouettes of where players walked in the last 10 minutes and glows where magic changed the terrain recently, around the aimed point.
glyph.arcane.arcane_fireworks.desc: Effect: colorful firework bursts over the targets. Only light and sound, no damage.
glyph.arcane.flower_trail.desc: Effect: for a while, the target leaves flowers on the grass wherever it walks.
glyph.arcane.bubbles.desc: Effect: bubbles pop around the target's head for a while.
glyph.arcane.tickle.desc: Effect: the target cannot keep still: it hops and giggles for a few seconds.
glyph.arcane.twirl.desc: Effect: the target spins a full turn in one second.
glyph.arcane.playful_shadow.desc: Effect: a little shadow hops around the target's feet for a while.
glyph.arcane.starry_sky.desc: Effect: a sky of little stars appears above the target for a while, visible to anyone nearby.
glyph.arcane.glow_item.desc: Effect: loose items near the targets get a glowing outline (visible through walls) for a while. Good for finding what you dropped.
glyph.arcane.melody.desc: Effect: a short harp melody plays at the target.
glyph.arcane.on_sleep.desc: Condition: arms the spell on you: what follows happens when you fall asleep (waits up to 1 game day).
glyph.arcane.on_fish.desc: Condition: arms the spell on you: what follows happens when you reel something out of the water (waits up to 1 game day).
glyph.arcane.on_dawn.desc: Condition: arms the spell on you: what follows happens at the next sunrise (also after sleeping; waits up to 1 game day).
glyph.arcane.on_eat.desc: Condition: arms the spell on you: what follows happens when you finish eating any food (waits up to 1 game day).
glyph.arcane.on_see_cast.desc: Condition: arms the spell on you: what follows happens when you see another creature cast a spell within 24 blocks (the caster becomes Counterspell's target). Waits up to 1 game day.
glyph.arcane.named.desc: Filter: only creatures with a name (name tag).
glyph.arcane.aerial.desc: Filter: only those in the air: flying creatures and anyone jumping, falling or gliding.
glyph.arcane.random.desc: Modifier: the previous effect's strength (damage, heal, radius, duration...) is rolled each cast, from half to double.
glyph.arcane.illusion.desc: Effect: creates 3 clones of you (visual only, up to 15 s) that copy your intent: they walk and run with you, attack with other weapons from your inventory when you attack and fake other spells when you cast. They hurt and touch nothing; one hit dispels them. Creatures aiming at you may pick a clone.
glyph.arcane.color.desc: Modifier: changes the color of this spell's casting circle and spiral (16 colors, in the parameter). Looks only.
gui.arcane.preview.warn.projectile_mods_: Homing, Ricochet, Fragment and Arc only work on the Projectile form: on %s they do nothing.
gui.arcane.preview.projectile_mods_degra: Projectile at the hit limit: it keeps %s bounces and %s shards.
gui.arcane.discoveries.empty: No reactions discovered yet. Mix elements and surroundings to see what happens.
reaction.arcane.conduction.hint: Storm on a wet target hurts more.
reaction.arcane.steam.hint: Fire on a wet target turns to steam: it puts out and dries.
reaction.arcane.flash_freeze.hint: Frost on a wet target freezes faster.
reaction.arcane.shatter.hint: Fire on a frozen target shatters the ice.
reaction.arcane.thaw.hint: Frost in a hot place loses strength.
reaction.arcane.hiss.hint: Frost on a burning target puts the fire out.
reaction.arcane.bloom.hint: Venom in forests and swamps hurts more.
reaction.arcane.vapor_cloud.hint: Lots of fire meeting lots of water at once raises a cloud that blinds, soaks and burns lightly.
gui.arcane.options.voice.tip: Each spell plays a short melody of its glyphs when cast (same spell, same melody).
message.arcane.voice.none: No active spell in the grimoire.
